summary: The bill amends 5 U.S.C. § 7342 to expand foreign gift reporting to presidential and congressional candidates, ban gifts from countries of concern, shift agency compilations to the Office of Government Ethics and State Department by May 15 with added details on value, tracking numbers, and disposition, require public online access, and impose $200 late fees.
